release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Runs long actions in isolated background processes with a configurable 30-minute default deadline, Action status with progress/results, and Stop running action that terminates the plugin worker group. Scheduled actions use the same controls; supervisor metadata failures also stop workers. Uses lean global Emby /Items bulk listings: ProviderIds and Path, up to 20,000 items per page, no MediaSources playback detail, and total counts checked only at the beginning/end. Keeps incomplete/repeated/changed snapshot guards and file-version matching. Complete Django catalogue queries project required columns, omit unused account joins, and avoid a second census unless a tracked show was refreshed. Retains native categories, SQLite bulk writes, raw STRM URL equality, edited NFO protection, settings help and scheduled snapshots. Live verification: 222,190 Emby items in 48 seconds; 627,500 catalogue rows in 95 seconds with three Django queries; earlier cleanup removed 807 STRMs with zero errors/warnings and preserved NFOs. Validation: 283 local tests passed with three Windows platform-specific skips, publisher/package/import checks passed.
